observations.behavior: Adds an explicit configuration to prevent PostHog's JS SDK from installing global exception handling.
observations.posthog_connection: This change targets the frontend toolbar initialization, explicitly opting out of automatic error capturing which could otherwise interfere with page performance or privacy expectations on customer-facing pages.

observations.limitations: Only one hunk provided; no tests, migration helpers, or broader architectural changes are visible. No evidence of compatibility issues or benefit realization.

review.reason: Narrow, localized maintenance/configuration adjustment. Prevents a potential side effect (global exceptions) without demonstrating systemic improvement.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant for customers using the public toolbar who may experience unexpected behavior if global exception handlers were installed.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on this single-line addition; lack of surrounding context prevents higher-tier assessment.
